titulo: Her tea waits until I sit down
caption:
Her tea waits until I sit down

My roommate never touches her tea until I sit down. Then I stopped coming home late.

A hot drink cools fastest at the start, so waiting for someone costs the first and warmest sips.

For whoever lets the tea cool so someone can start with them.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, and two orange mugs with steam sit on the floor in the middle. A bubble says tea's ready. Then I'll wait, and the figure tilts and holds still while the steam keeps rising. A brick red figure walks in from the right and a bubble says sorry, late! The black one's eyes go wide and then happy, a bubble says now we start, and both pulse as the steam stops. The text stays: me not touching my tea until you get here. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
